proposals.evidence: Probable borrowed regional colour adjective. Perder Table23 places gulabi pink among invariable adjectives, and section9.2 discusses borrowed -i adjectives that do not take Dameli feminine agreement. OPED32639 independently attests Pashto ګلابي (displayed gulaabi as an alternative colloquial transliteration), pink/rose-coloured. This closely matches form and meaning, but Perder does not explicitly identify Pashto as the donor of this individual word; other regional transmission remains possible. No standalone donor node was found. Do not analyse the final -i as the Dameli feminine suffix or invent a synchronic Dameli rose-base derivation. No specifically Nuristani donor established.
